title: Register positions lie in their boxes
statement: Let a call specification have an argument list with no repetitions, and let $s$ be less than the argument-list length. For any track position $tp$ that is valid for segment $s$ of the virtual input, the position assigned to each register by the call-position rule lies in its register box: registers outside the argument list retain their initial work-tape positions, while each register in the list has position between $-1$ and the length of its word, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: Track position is valid for segment $s$
